title_cyr: Ај што убаво одат ле мамо
title_latin: Aj što ubavo odat le mamo
title_en: How beautifully they walk, oh mother
en_note: Machine translation by Claude (my reading), not on Pesna.org and not checked by a native speaker. Treat it as a study aid.
translator_notes: Origin unclear. 'тувенчиња' is a guess (my reading: kerchiefs), and 'сите ми се блеат' is my reading (they all bleat/coo, i.e. speak sweetly). Ајта is a wide white festive dress.

lines.cyr: Ај, што убаво одат, ле мамо, велешките моми
lines.lat: Aj, što ubavo odat, le mamo, veleškite momi
lines.en: Oh, how beautifully they walk, oh mother, the girls of Veles

lines.cyr: ај, што убаво одат, ле мамо, рамна снага вијат
lines.lat: aj, što ubavo odat, le mamo, ramna snaga vijat
lines.en: oh, they carry a straight figure, oh mother,

lines.cyr: рамна снага вијат, ле мамо, со очи те пијат.
lines.lat: ramna snaga vijat, le mamo, so oči te pijat.
lines.en: they carry a straight figure, oh mother, they drink you in with their eyes.

lines.cyr: Ај, сите бре врзале, ле мамо, бели тувенчиња
lines.lat: Aj, site bre vrzale, le mamo, beli tuvenčinja
lines.en: Oh, they have all tied on, oh mother, white kerchiefs

lines.en: oh, they have all put on, oh mother, red dresses

lines.lat: alovi f`stančinja, le mamo, beli ajtičinja.
lines.en: red dresses, oh mother, white ajta dresses.

lines.cyr: Ај, кога одат, мила ле мамо, како ветер вејат
lines.lat: Aj, koga odat, mila le mamo, kako veter vejat
lines.en: Oh, when they walk, dear oh mother, they blow like the wind

lines.lat: aj, koga stojat, mila le mamo, kako sonce grejat
lines.en: oh, when they stand, dear oh mother, they warm like the sun

lines.cyr: кога зборат, мила ле мамо, сите ми се блеат.
lines.lat: koga zborat, mila le mamo, site mi se bleat.
lines.en: when they speak, dear oh mother, they all bleat/coo.

lines.cyr: А велешки ергени, ле мамо, многу намрштени
lines.lat: A veleški ergeni, le mamo, mnogu namršteni
lines.en: But the bachelors of Veles, oh mother, are very frowning

lines.lat: aj, oni sakaat, mila le mamo, moma da e skromna
lines.en: oh, they want, dear oh mother, a girl to be modest

lines.cyr: мома да е скромна, ле мамо, да си седи дома.

lines.en: a girl to be modest, oh mother, to stay at home.
